reason: AMD-02, 6 Jan 2027 — volume moved from Charcoal Melange to Off White; total unchanged at 42,000 pcs
_notes: The mail states FOUR changed cells and the schema wants the WHOLE grid — `applyRevision` replaces the revision wholesale, because a partial update leaves cells the new grid does not mention and 'the ratio still has an XXL nobody ordered' is a real way to over-cut. An extraction returning only the four changed cells is a finding, and the approve screen shows the total to catch it: four cells sum to 15,600, not 42,000.

The unchanged eleven cells are NOT on this paper. They come from the order's current revision, which is why this door is worth a human reading before it commits — the model has to carry forward what the document does not repeat.
Total must still be 42,000. The buyer says so in prose ('unchanged at 42,000 pcs') and the arithmetic agrees; a grid that does not sum to it is refused by the tolerance check, not merely flagged.

Ex-factory is mentioned and must NOT be drafted here — this schema carries the grid and a reason, nothing else. AMD-01 is the date amendment and it is a different door (a TNA date is actualised, never drafted).
AMD-01 (05-…) has no expected.json on purpose: it changes only the ex-factory date, and there is no intake kind that drafts a date. It is kit paper for the LC-conflict walk, not for an extractor.
